claims.text: The FDA estazolam label says alcohol with sedative-hypnotics appears to increase the risk of behaviors such as sleep driving.
claims.quote: Although behaviors such as sleep driving may occur with sedative-hypnotics alone at therapeutic doses, the use of alcohol and other CNS depressants with sedative-hypnotics appears to increase the risk of such behaviors

claims.text: The French estazolam label says alcohol increases the sedative effect of benzodiazepines and related drugs.
claims.quote: Majoration par l'alcool de l'effet sédatif des benzodiazépines et apparentés.
claims.quoteEnglish: Alcohol increases the sedative effect of benzodiazepines and related drugs.

headline.text: The FDA estazolam label links alcohol with increased risk of behaviors such as sleep driving.

reported.text: The French label also describes increased benzodiazepine sedation with alcohol.
